sources.entry: FitTrackee - Simple workout/activity tracker. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: FitTrackee is a self-hosted web application for tracking outdoor workouts and activities by importing files from devices or apps, with data kept on your own server.
summary.what_it_does: It imports workout data from files exported by mobile apps or devices, so activities are stored on your own server. Workouts can also be added manually without a file. It uses map data from OpenStreetMap. The README lists example compatible Android apps (FitoTrack, OpenTracks, OSMAnd, Runner Up) and smartwatch-related tools (Amazfish, Gadgetbridge). It includes a command line interface and documentation covering features, installation, third-party tools, and troubleshooting. Translations are managed through Weblate.
use_cases: importing activity files from a phone or watch
keeping fitness data on my own server
viewing workouts on an OpenStreetMap map
notable: Imports workout files exported from other apps and devices rather than requiring a single tracking app
Also allows adding workouts without a file
Main repository on Codeberg; GitHub is a mirror used for tests and package/Docker builds
caveats: README says it is under heavy development and some features may be unstable
Test coverage is only reported for the Python API and CLI
Installation steps are not given in the README itself; it links to separate documentation
keywords: share workouts with my own server
